summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Woori Financial Group Inc., a Korean foreign private issuer, announcing its 2026 first-half earnings release conference scheduled for July 24, 2026. The filing provides details on the agenda, date, time, format (live audio webcast and conference call), and registration instructions. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. It is a routine earnings announcement notice, analogous to an earnings press release in the US, and does not constitute a special situation.
